subtitle: The Night the Lion Took Back His Den

panels.shot: dramatic low-angle night wide of Lal Mahal under moonlight
panels.action: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj stands in shadow atop a Pune rooftop, eyes fixed on the lamplit bulk of Lal Mahal where Mughal guards patrol, the dark city spread below.

dialogue.text: Pune, 1663: Aurangzeb’s own uncle sleeps in Shivaji’s seized palace. That night, the Maratha lion walks back into his den.

i18n.hi: पुणे, 1663: औरंगज़ेब का मामा खुद शिवाजी के छीने महल में सोता है। उसी रात मराठा शेर फिर अपने मांद में लौटता है।

panels.shot: slow aerial drift over the Deccan plateau at dusk
panels.action: The Deccan hills darken under a fading sky, a thin line of dust showing a distant army road as lamps flicker in the valley town of Pune.

dialogue.text: By 1663, the Deccan shook with a new name. Shivaji, son of a minor jagirdar, had broken forts and treaties, and dared the Mughal throne itself.

i18n.hi: 1663 तक दक्खन एक नए नाम से काँपता था। छोटे जगीरदार का बेटा शिवाजी किले तोड़ चुका था, संधियाँ फाड़ चुका था, और सीधे मुगल तख़्त को ललकार चुका था।

panels.shot: medium shot of Aurangzeb on throne in a dim imperial hall (shown from behind, face not detailed)
panels.action: A richly robed figure of the Mughal emperor sits upon a high throne in a shadowed hall, courtiers in silhouette around him as a map of the Deccan lies open below.

dialogue.text: Aurangzeb, new on the throne, saw the western hills as a test of his will. To crush this hill chief, he sent one of his most trusted kin.

i18n.hi: तख़्त पर नया-नया बैठा औरंगज़ेब पश्चिमी घाट को अपनी हिम्मत की क़सौटी मानता था। इस पहाड़ी नायक को रौंदने वह अपने सबसे भरोसेमंद रिश्तेदार को भेजता है।

panels.shot: commanding mid-shot of Shaista Khan in a Mughal camp tent
panels.action: Shaista Khan, bearded and imposing in Mughal armour and turban, stands within a Deccan campaign tent, officers behind him as a scribe unfurls an imperial farman.

dialogue.text: Shaista Khan, Aurangzeb’s uncle and veteran of imperial wars, marched south with tens of thousands. He seized Pune, the heart of Shivaji’s childhood.

i18n.hi: शाइस्ता ख़ाँ, औरंगज़ेब का मामा और पुराने बादशाही जंगों का सिपहसालार, लाखों की फ़ौज लेकर दक्षिण बढ़ा। उसने शिवाजी के बचपन का दिल, पुणे, छीन लिया।

panels.shot: wide shot of Lal Mahal courtyard under foreign occupation
panels.action: The red walls of Lal Mahal loom over a courtyard now crowded with Mughal tents and horses; imperial soldiers lounge where children once played, a Maratha household turned into a garrison.

dialogue.text: Lal Mahal, once Jijabai’s home and the young Shivaji’s school of dreams, became the Mughal viceroy’s Deccan residence. The conqueror slept in the rebel’s own rooms.

i18n.hi: लाल महल, जो कभी जिजाबाई का घर और छोटे शिवाजी का सपनों का पाठशाला था, अब दक्खन में मुगल सूबेदार का घर बन गया। फ़तह का बादशाह बाग़ी के ही कमरों में सोने लगा।

panels.shot: tight medium of Shivaji in a hillside hideout, lit by a small lamp
panels.action: Shivaji sits cross-legged in a stone-walled hideout, armour at his side, eyes hard as he studies a rough map of Pune by the light of a single oil lamp.

dialogue.text: From the hills, Shivaji watched his boyhood city under foreign standards. Every lamp in Lal Mahal was a thorn. Every Mughal drumbeat, an insult.

i18n.hi: पहाड़ों से शिवाजी अपने बचपन का शहर परायी पताकाओं तले देखता रहा। लाल महल की हर बाती एक काँटा थी। हर मुग़ल नगाड़ा, एक तौहीन।

panels.shot: close-up on Shivaji’s face, half in shadow, as he looks up from the map
panels.action: Shivaji raises his head from the map, jaw set, the play of shadow and lamplight catching the determination in his narrowed eyes.

dialogue.speaker: chhatrapati_shivaji_maharaj
dialogue.text: He calls this his house. We will remind him whose it is.

i18n.hi: कहता है ये उसका घर है। अब उसे याद दिलाते हैं, असली मालिक कौन है।

panels.shot: overhead shot of a small war council around the map
panels.action: Shivaji leans over the map with a handful of close lieutenants whose faces stay indistinct, fingers tracing lanes and gates leading into a tiny sketch of Lal Mahal.

dialogue.text: Maratha bakhars describe a small chosen band. The Mughal records, written in another camp, agree on one point: the viceroy never imagined they would come.

i18n.hi: मराठा बख़रों में कुछ चुने हुए वीरों की टुकड़ी का ज़िक्र है। दूसरी तरफ़ के मुगल काग़ज़ भी एक बात मानते हैं: सूबेदार ने सपने में भी नहीं सोचा था, वे आ धमकेंगे।

panels.shot: moody street-level shot of Pune at night
panels.action: Narrow lanes of Pune lie under soft moonlight; a few braziers glow by doorways as barefoot townsfolk slip into shadows, while distant Mughal sentries stand bored at a gate.

dialogue.text: How did they enter? Some later tellings speak of wedding processions, others of secret posterns. The records agree only on the hour: deep night, when the city’s breath was slow.

i18n.hi: वे घुसे कैसे? कुछ क़िस्सों में बारात बनकर, कुछ में गुप्त पिछवाड़े से। दफ़्तरों में बस एक बात तय है: गहरी रात, जब शहर की साँसें धीमी थीं।

panels.shot: low, tracking shot behind Shivaji and raiders moving through shadowed alleys
panels.action: Shivaji moves at the head of a compact group of armed men, their forms cloaked and silent as they slip through a dark lane, hugging walls and skirting pools of torchlight.

dialogue.text: Sarkar, weighing Mughal and Maratha sources, speaks of forty to fifty men. Enough to strike, not to hold. A knife, not a sword.

i18n.hi: सरदार के हिसाब से, मुगल और मराठा दोनों का तुलनात्मक पढ़ने पर, चालीस–पचास जाँबाज़ दिखते हैं। वार करने भर, टिकने भर नहीं। खंजर, तलवार नहीं।

panels.shot: medium shot at a palace wall, hint of a postern or balcony
panels.action: The massive outline of Lal Mahal rises ahead as Shivaji pauses beneath a shadowed section of wall, gesturing low while one raider prepares a rope toward a dark balcony above.

dialogue.text: Maratha tradition tells of ropes and hidden ways known from childhood. The Mughal akhbarat, terse and embarrassed, notes only a breach of ‘carelessness’ at the gate.

i18n.hi: मराठा दास्तानें बचपन से जाने रस्सों और गुप्त रस्तों की बात करती हैं। सख़्त, शर्मीला मुगल अखबारात सिर्फ़ इतना लिख पाता है कि फ़ाटक पर ‘ग़फ़लत’ हो गई।

panels.shot: interior long shot of Lal Mahal corridor with sleeping guards
panels.action: Inside Lal Mahal, a wide corridor lined with carved pillars holds dozing Mughal guards slumped by their spears as Shivaji’s shadowed figure emerges at one end, blade drawn low.

dialogue.text: Within, habit dulled vigilance. Years of imperial victory had taught Shaista Khan to fear armies at his gates, not footsteps in his halls.

i18n.hi: अंदर आदत ने चौकसी को सुस्त कर दिया था। सल्तनती जीतों ने शाइस्ता ख़ाँ को फ़क़त फ़ौजों से डरना सिखाया था, हवेलियों में दबे क़दमों से नहीं।

panels.shot: tense medium shot outside a closed chamber door
panels.action: Shivaji stands close to a heavy wooden door carved with floral patterns, his palm resting on it as if feeling the presence within, his men waiting behind him in breath-held stillness.

dialogue.text: Some bakhars say Shivaji reached the very chamber where the viceroy slept, guided by the memories of a son who had run in these passages as a boy.

i18n.hi: कुछ बख़र कहते हैं, शिवाजी सीधे उसी कोठरी तक पहुँचा, जहाँ सूबेदार सोता था, उन गलियारों की याद में, जहाँ वही लड़का कभी भागा-दौड़ा था।

panels.shot: dynamic interior shot as the door swings open
panels.action: The chamber door bursts inward, revealing a richly furnished room with shadows of startled figures rising from low beds as armed intruders surge through the doorway.

dialogue.text: What followed, the sources agree, lasted moments. A rush. A shout. The crack of panic in a place that had felt invulnerable.

i18n.hi: आगे जो हुआ, सब दस्तावेज़ मानते हैं, बस कुछ साँसों का खेल था। धावा। एक हुंकार। और उस जगह में दहशत की किरकिराहट, जो खुद को अजेय मानती थी।

panels.shot: sharp, frozen moment on Shaista Khan recoiling, his hand struck aside (no gore)
panels.action: Shaista Khan recoils on a low bed, face twisted in shock, his raised hand meeting the arc of a sword, the impact shown only by the spray of a severed jeweled ring and flying cloth.

dialogue.text: Akhbarat letters from April 1663 report it plainly: the Khan’s fingers were cut, his honour wounded far worse than his flesh.

i18n.hi: अप्रैल 1663 के अखबारात साफ़ लिखते हैं: ख़ाँ की उँगलियाँ कट गईं, उसकी इज़्ज़त उसके हाथ से कहीं ज़्यादा जख्मी हुई।

panels.shot: wide shot in the same chamber showing confusion and a fallen youth (no blood)
panels.action: In the chaotic room, a young noble lies motionless near an overturned stool while attendants scatter; beyond him, armed figures retreat toward the darkened doorway.

dialogue.text: In the confusion, his son fell. The Alamgirnama, written for Aurangzeb’s court, cannot hide this fact. It drapes it in pious phrases, but the wound to prestige is clear.

i18n.hi: हड़कंप में उसका बेटा मारा गया। औरंगज़ेब के दरबार के लिए लिखी आलमगीरनामा यह बात छुपा नहीं पाती। बस ख़ुदा-ख़ुदा की चादर डाल देती है, पर इज़्ज़त का ज़ख्म साफ़ झलकता है।

panels.shot: medium shot of Shivaji at the threshold, turning to withdraw
panels.action: Shivaji stands briefly silhouetted in the chamber doorway, looking back with a hard, unreadable expression before motioning his men to melt once more into the palace shadows.

dialogue.speaker: chhatrapati_shivaji_maharaj
dialogue.text: We came for a mark, not a massacre. The mark is made.

i18n.hi: हम खून की होली नहीं, बस एक निशान के लिए आए थे। निशान लग चुका।

panels.shot: fast, blurred long shot of raiders escaping into the night streets
panels.action: Figures dart through a narrow Pune street under starlight, their outlines blurred with speed as distant shouts and torch-glows rise behind them from Lal Mahal’s direction.

dialogue.text: Sabhasad’s bakhar celebrates a clean escape. The Mughal letters, defensive and strained, hint at a frantic pursuit that grasped only empty air.

i18n.hi: सभासद की बख़र इसे बेदाग़ बच निकलना मानती है। मुगल खत, सफ़ाई और तनाव से भरे, बस हवा में टटोलते पीछा का अंदेशा दिखाते हैं।

panels.shot: interior shot of Aurangzeb reading a report, lit by a single lamp
panels.action: In a sombre chamber, Aurangzeb sits rigid as a courtier kneels, holding out a folded report; the emperor’s eyes narrow as he reads, shadow deepening around his face.

dialogue.text: Within weeks, news reached Delhi. An uncle of the emperor, struck in his own bed, in a house taken from a rebel now turned ghost.

i18n.hi: कुछ ही हफ्तों में ख़बर दिल्ली पहुँची। बादशाह का मामा, अपने बिस्तर में घायल, उस घर में जो एक बाग़ी से छीना था, जो अब भूत बनकर लौटा।

panels.shot: formal court scene as Shaista Khan stands before Aurangzeb, hands bandaged
panels.action: Shaista Khan stands before the throne, his right hand wrapped and hidden in a sleeve, head bowed as Aurangzeb sits aloof, courtiers watching with carefully blank faces.

dialogue.text: Punishment followed. The emperor, unable to undo the night, removed Shaista Khan from the Deccan and sent him away to Bengal, far from the hills that had humbled him.

i18n.hi: सज़ा आई। बादशाह उस रात को पलट नहीं सकता था, पर शाइस्ता ख़ाँ को दक्खन से हटा दिया और दूर बंगाल भेज दिया, उन पहाड़ियों से, जिन्होंने उसे झुका दिया था।

panels.shot: symbolic wide shot of Pune with Mughal banners taken down from Lal Mahal
panels.action: A dawn view of Pune shows the red bulk of Lal Mahal in the distance; its Mughal banners are being lowered by small figures, while ordinary townsfolk watch from rooftops and lanes.

dialogue.text: The raid did not end the war. But it shattered an illusion. Fortress or palace, no Mughal hold in the Deccan could now be called safe.

i18n.hi: धावा जंग का अंत नहीं था। पर उसने एक भरम तोड़ दिया। किला हो या महल, दक्खन में अब कोई मुगल ठिकाना पूरी तरह महफ़ूज़ नहीं कहलाया।

panels.shot: montage-like wide shot of Maratha and mixed troops in open country
panels.action: On an open plain beneath low hills, riders in varied turbans and armour form loose companies, Maratha horsemen alongside bearded Muslim officers, banners of different colours flapping together in the wind.

dialogue.text: Shivaji’s own ranks were no single faith’s army. Men like Siddi Ibrahim and Daulat Khan rode for him, proving this was not a war against a creed, but against the weight of empire.

i18n.hi: शिवाजी की क़तारें किसी एक मज़हब की फ़ौज नहीं थीं। सिद्दी इब्राहिम और दौलत ख़ाँ जैसे लोग उसके लिए लड़े, साबित करते हुए कि ये लड़ाई किसी आस्था से नहीं, सल्तनत की गर्दन से थी।

panels.shot: medium shot of Shivaji on a hilltop at sunrise, Pune in the distance
panels.action: Shivaji stands on a rocky hill at sunrise, cloak fluttering, looking down toward the distant outline of Pune and Lal Mahal, the light catching a faint, tired smile at the corner of his mouth.

dialogue.text: For Shivaji, it was more than vengeance. It was a message in steel and silence: that even a vast empire could be forced to flinch by a single, measured strike.

i18n.hi: शिवाजी के लिए ये सिर्फ़ बदला नहीं था। ये इस्पात और सन्नाटे में लिखा पैगाम था: कि एक मापा हुआ वार भी एक विशाल सल्तनत को थरथरा सकता है।

panels.shot: quiet close-up of a broken Mughal signboard of Lal Mahal lying on the ground
panels.action: A wooden plaque carved in elegant Persian script lies cracked on the earth, its surface dusty, while bare feet of commoners and soldiers alike step past it without pause.

dialogue.text: Chronicles on both sides recorded that April night with unease. In their careful words, we glimpse its real power: after Lal Mahal, even emperors had to imagine the unexpected.

i18n.hi: दोनों तरफ़ की तवारीख़ ने उस अप्रैल की रात को झिझक के साथ दर्ज किया। उनके सँभले लफ़्ज़ों में असल असर झलकता है: लाल महल के बाद, बादशाहों को भी अनहोनी सोचनी पड़ी।

panels.shot: final contemplative close-up on Shivaji’s profile against a starry sky
panels.action: Shivaji’s profile is outlined against a deep night sky filled with stars, his gaze turned upward and outward, expression calm yet alert, as if listening for distant drums.

dialogue.text: The Lal Mahal raid reminds us that power is not only in numbers or walls, but in daring, timing and purpose—and that a single night’s resolve can redraw what a mighty foe thinks is possible.

i18n.hi: लाल महल का धावा याद दिलाता है कि ताक़त सिर्फ़ सरगिनती या दीवारों में नहीं, जुर्रत, वक़्त और मक़सद में भी होती है—और कि एक रात का जज़्बा भी किसी दुर्जेय दुश्मन की सोच की हदें बदल सकता है।

title_i18n.en: Lal Mahal Raid on Shaista Khan
title_i18n.hi: शाइस्ता ख़ाँ पर लाल महल धावा

subtitle_i18n.en: The Night the Lion Took Back His Den
subtitle_i18n.hi: उस रात शेर ने अपना मांद वापस ली
